trap.label: too vs very
trap.why: Em português 'muito' serve para tudo; em inglês too tem sentido negativo (excesso), very é só intensidade.

mcq.q: I can't lift it. It's ___ heavy.
He isn't strong ___ to lift it.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com too: “It is very small for me.” (to wear)
rewrite.answer: It is too small for me to wear.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com enough: “It isn't warm.” (to swim)
rewrite.answer: It isn't warm enough to swim.
